 Bike News Honda ADV125 Maxi-Scooter Breaks Cover at EICMA 2026
 Written by Mayank Gupta November 3, 2026 
 It is developed for young urban riders with a A1 license in the European nations; India launch still unconfirmed
 Honda ADV125 has made its global debut at the EICMA 2026 in Milan, Italy. The smallest maxi-scooter by the Japanese brand is developed for A1 license holders in the European nations. Honda claims that the ADV125 is an amalgamation of X-ADV’s distinctive appeal and ADV350’s adventurous spirit. The brand had recently launched the ADV160 in the Indian market at a price point of Rs 1.70 lakh (ex-showroom). We could also see the ADV125 or a similar maxi-scooter based on it for India in the coming months as the company looks to strengthen its scooter portfolio in our country.
 Honda ADV125 is offered with a newly developed 5-inch full-colored instrument console which boasts of a TFT display and smartphone connectivity through Honda RoadSync app. Some of the prominent highlights of the maxi-scooter are 165 mm of ground clearance, long-travel suspension, 29-litre under-seat storage area, 2 litres front storage compartment and semi-knobby tyres.
 The ADV125 has a low saddle height of 780. It gets a windscreen which is adjustable across five positions and can be moved up to a distance of 75 mm. A few notable features onboard the maxi-scooter are Smart Key, USB-C socket, Start/Stop button and switchable HSTC traction control. It has a fuel tank capacity of 8.1 litres which ensures a long range of around 385 km in one go.
 Honda ADV125 Maxi-Scooter At the heart, Honda ADV125 has the 125 cc single-cylinder eSP+ engine which generates max power of 12.3 bhp and peak torque of 11.7 Nm. The official mileage figures revealed by Honda is 47.6 kmpl on the WMTC cycle. Hence, with a fully-filled tank of 8.1 litres, one can travel up to 385 km without the need of refuelling. The maxi-scooter has a top speed of 97 kmph.
 Among the original accessories, the customers can opt for 40-litre Smart Top Box, heated grips and alarm. The ADV125 comes in four colours options namely Pearl Falcon Grey, Pearl Cool White, Mat Cynos Gray Metallic and Mat Pearl Diaspro Red. Sitting on a steel tubular underbone chassis, it is offered with telescopic front forks and twin shock rear suspension.
 Honda ADV125 Maxi-Scooter Riding on 14-inch front and 13-inch rear wheels, Honda ADV125 110/80 section front and 130/70 section rear tubeless Pirelli/Tourance tyres. The braking duties are handled by 240mm front and 220mm rear disc brakes, which are assisted by a single-channel ABS. The maxi-scooter tips the weighing scale at 133 kg.
